assertions: Two pages have distinct learning outcomes and working continuation links.
Commands are reproducible from a stated directory with prerequisites and observed results.
A shared contract and claim evidence preserve the target fixture scope.
Validation and human review status are recorded separately from findings-only output.
Source files remain unchanged and no unsupported portability or performance claim is added.
